title: # Build: auto-land-2 (Urgent profile) - replaces stopped `auto-land` Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice).
asked: # Build: auto-land-2 (Urgent profile) - replaces stopped `auto-land` Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice). Assigned agent: **Earl the Ear** (book on his card; AXF_AGENT=earl-the-ear if supported). Register in Urgent (id `auto-land`, note the relaunch) + banner entry. ## Brett's correction: ZERO TOKENS for merging Do NOT build an AI agent that lands every PR. The push banner already has batch merge (push batches / 'the bundle': PRs queued into a batch, batch merge, ui-review@1 holds respected, merge order). Reuse it. The whole auto-merge path must be plain scripts (Node/Python) on the VPS / console server, no LLM calls. An AI agent is called ONLY when a merge truly needs judgement (a real code conflict the script can't resolve, or CI red with a code fix needed), and then any free agent via the all-rounder router. ## Steps - s0 Read the push banner plugin's batch merge + auto-merge code and the land scripts (`vps.build_land`, framework/cli land/agent-job). Write in the report what already exists. Land PR #265 crew-retrain via the existing script path if it isn't on main. - s1 Script pipeline: build finishes -> the PR is added to the batch automatically -> script cleans the worktree (commit stray synced files on the build's own branch, skip .brief.md/*.log/*.jsonl, back up untracked duplicates to /root/archive/), merges origin/main in, auto-resolves store/THREADS/logs with the orch-live-sync rules, waits for CI, batch-merges if green and not held, in dependency order. Status commits stay `[skip ci]`. - s2 UI Review stays the gate: held PRs wait; the moment Brett approves the UI, the batch merges it by itself. - s3 Stop claude-sync dropping files into finished/landing worktrees. - s4 Blocked = one push to Brett in plain words (UI waiting, CI red + failing check, conflict, dependency) + the What's New 'Ready to merge' reason. Only conflicts/red CI that need a code change create an agent job. - s5 Fix the empty console: axf-console `overview` / `build_queue` / plan return 0 while builds run; make them read the live store; health@1 check goes red if the console sees zero builds while builds are running. - s6 Settings > Builds: 'Auto-land finished builds' (on), 'Wait for UI Review' (on). Commands declared once -> REST + MCP + CLI (land now, hold, release, list blocked). - s7 Test that fails the build if the merge pipeline imports any LLM client (like the chat engine rule); pipeline tests with fake builds; report `_claude/builds/reports/auto-land.md`; THREADS; PR; steps through the store. Commits clean and professional. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches (Brett, Nov 3 2026): a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. An UPGRADE (e.g. Opus → Fable) needs Brett's approval: when you reach one, run `node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs request-upgrade <id> <phase>`, ask once, and stop. Never approve a model switch upgrade yourself (no `act approve` on an upgrade), never relaunch on a higher model.

result.summary: Auto-land: finished builds land by plain scripts (push-banner/land/land.mjs host cron + push banner auto-merge), zero model calls; status-only commits no longer make PRs behind; skipped checks aren't CI; blocked = one plain push, agent only for code conflict/red CI; console overview/queue/plan read the builds store + health check; settings + REST/MCP/CLI commands; no-LLM test. Also #267 (red main CI) and axHub#36 (claude-sync hold).
